tagline.en: Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) — an imitation-learning robot policy that predicts action chunks from camera observations.
tagline.zh: Action Chunking Transformer（ACT）——一个模仿学习机器人策略，从相机观测预测动作块。

en: ACT, the Action Chunking Transformer, is a classic imitation-learning policy for robot manipulation, from Tony Zhao and collaborators. Instead of predicting one action at a time, it predicts short chunks of future actions, which makes execution smoother and more robust.

Architecturally it is a DETR-style transformer with a conditional VAE (DETR-VAE) and a ResNet image backbone: camera observations go in, and a trajectory of chunked actions comes out. In WorldFoundry the inference-only policy runs in-tree and emits an action trace that downstream embodied benchmarks can replay.

The upstream repository publishes training and evaluation recipes but not a ready-made pretrained policy, so running prediction requires you to stage your own trained checkpoint and its matching dataset statistics.
zh: ACT，即 Action Chunking Transformer，是 Tony Zhao 及合作者提出的经典模仿学习机器人操作策略。它不是一次预测一个动作，而是预测未来一小段动作块，从而让执行更平滑、更稳健。
在架构上，它是 DETR 风格的 Transformer，配合条件 VAE（DETR-VAE）与 ResNet 图像主干：输入相机观测，输出分块动作的轨迹。在 WorldFoundry 中，仅推理的策略在代码树内运行，产出可供下游具身基准回放的动作轨迹。
上游仓库公开了训练与评测配方，但未提供现成的预训练策略，因此运行预测需要你自行准备训练好的 checkpoint 及其匹配的数据集统计量。

whenToUse.en: Use ACT when you want a proven action-chunking imitation policy for robot manipulation and you have (or will train) your own checkpoint and dataset statistics.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个成熟的动作分块模仿策略用于机器人操作，并且已有（或将训练）自己的 checkpoint 与数据集统计量时，选择 ACT。

notFor.en: No pretrained policy is shipped — you must stage a trained policy checkpoint and matching dataset statistics before it can predict actions.
notFor.zh: 不附带预训练策略——需先准备训练好的策略 checkpoint 与匹配的数据集统计量，才能预测动作。

en: Action-chunking imitation policy for robot manipulation
DETR-VAE transformer with a ResNet image backbone
Outputs a replayable action trace for embodied benchmarks
Runs inference-only in-tree with your staged checkpoint
zh: 面向机器人操作的动作分块模仿策略
DETR-VAE Transformer 搭配 ResNet 图像主干
输出可供具身基准回放的动作轨迹
以推理模式内置运行，使用你准备的 checkpoint
